integrity: Independent mathematical review checked the width-peak proof and rare-baseline-detection scaling. The fixed-width optimizer is credited to an equivalent catalogue statement. Archived computations are supplementary; no laboratory validation, formal certification or historical-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two symmetric, conditionally independent half-normal detectors; fixed baseline probability; known planar Gaussian activity centres. The result maximizes coverage over spacing at fixed width, then studies the maximum of that spacing curve. It does not maximize coverage over width or concern estimator precision, arbitrary layouts or field calibration.
title: A unique detection width of maximum optimal spacing for two symmetric Gaussian cameras
